shared_context.topic: Taking NyQuil and Benadryl at the same time

snippets.output: It is not recommended to take NyQuil and Benadryl at the same time because both NyQuil and Benadryl contain antihistamines.
snippets.pattern_notes: Recommendation (atom 1) merged with its reason (atom 2) via 'because'. Pattern B causal/conditional chain.

snippets.output: Taking NyQuil and Benadryl together can increase the risk of side effects, including severe drowsiness, dizziness, confusion, and impaired coordination.
snippets.pattern_notes: General side-effect claim (atom 5) plus enumerated specific side effects (atoms 6-9). Pattern A enumeration.

snippets.output: Combining NyQuil and Benadryl can potentially lead to an antihistamine overdose, and an antihistamine overdose can be dangerous.
snippets.pattern_notes: Causal chain: combining drugs -> antihistamine overdose -> dangerous outcome.
